description: Memory-only test case 1. Tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall.

steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
Sounds lovely — glad you had a relaxing weekend with Maria. Do you want help sharing this by email? I can draft or send one for you. Tell me who the recipient is (or give me an address) and whether you want it sent now or saved as a draft.

If it helps, here are three ready-to-use options you can pick or edit:

1) Quick casual update (short)
- Subject: Quick weekend update — countryside trip
- Body: Hi [Name], I just got back from a relaxing weekend in the countryside with my sister, Maria. We explored nature trails, soaked up the fresh air, and had a great time unplugging. Hope you’re well — let’s catch up soon. Best, [Your name]

2) Friendly detailed recap (with highlights)
- Subject: Countryside weekend with Maria — highlights
- Body: Hi [Name], I wanted to share a bit about my weekend — Maria and I went to the countryside for a short getaway. We spent our days exploring scenic nature trails, spotting birds, and enjoying long walks with fresh air and quiet. We also found a lovely little cafe and watched an amazing sunset one evening. It felt great to unwind and recharge. Hope things are going well with you — would love to hear what you’ve been up to. Take care, [Your name]

3) Photo-forward note (attach pictures)
- Subject: Photos from my weekend in the countryside
- Body: Hi [Name], Maria and I spent the weekend in the countryside and took some photos of the trails and views — attaching a few favorites. We had a very relaxing time exploring nature and enjoying the fresh air. Thought you might like these. Hope you enjoy them! Best, [Your name]

Which option do you want to send (1, 2, or 3)? Or would you like a different tone/length or to include specific photos or details? If you want me to actually send or save the draft, tell me the recipient email and whether to send now or save as a draft.

success_check.query:
The user asked: 'What did I do during the weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria?'. 

The agent's response must demonstrate that it correctly remembers and answers this question based on information that was previously shared. 

The response should contain the following information: I had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.

The key details that must be present are: Exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.

IMPORTANT: 
- The agent's response should show that it remembers the specific information that was explicitly stated
- The response does not need to be a direct quote - it can be rephrased or include additional context
- For RAG and Context memory backends, the response may include retrieved context or conversation history, which is acceptable
- The response should demonstrate clear recall of the key details (names, dates, facts) even if the wording differs slightly
- If the agent asks clarifying questions, that is acceptable as long as it also demonstrates that it remembers the relevant information
- Partial matches are acceptable if the core information is present (e.g., "The Daily Grind" matches "Daily Grind" or "coffee shop called The Daily Grind")
